name: Chaos Breed, Greater
body:
School transmutation [chaotic]; Level antipaladin 4, cleric/oracle 8, sorcerer/wizard 8

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like lesser chaos breed, except your blindsense is 20 feet; DR 10/chaotic; immunity to acid, resistance to electricity and sonic 10; you gain the benefits of freedom of movement, and amorphous anatomy. Also, your flight gives you a fly speed of 60 feet with good maneuverability.

The amorphous anatomy gives you a 50% chance to ignore criticals and precision damage, and immunity to polymorph effects, unless you are willing.
